name: markdown-document
body: A markdown source file scanned as a document: its headings are sections (symbols) nested by heading level. The document is the unit the markdown frontend discovers and emits. Each heading is a Struct section contained by the File (a top-level heading) or by the nearest preceding lower-level heading (Struct→Struct); a heading-less document yields no section Struct — only its File node. A section is a Struct because only Struct can contain Struct under the graph schema. There is NO synthesized document-root Struct: it existed solely to give whole-document/preamble links a representable Struct source/target, and markdown links are DEFERRED (requirements.note.markdown-links-deferred), so it is retired with the link feature. Realised by the markdown frontend.
